review.notes: Full read-through of all OCR lines against extracted text from all 21 physical PDF pages, plus a numeric-token multiset comparison covering table cells; physical pages 5, 10 and 21 were rendered to verify equations (1)-(5) and reference [49]. The OCR contains no code fences and no swallowed blocks. The arXiv side stamp on page 1 is page furniture, and all other unmatched lines are LaTeX-equivalent math renderings (\times, \tau) or figure-internal labels of embedded figures, not defects. Table 4 prints en-dash placeholder cells for VoiceSculptor that the OCR records as hyphens; both render as a dash, left unchanged.
